statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient is coded with I48.0 and I48.91
The symptoms are intermittent and must be correlated with rhythm disturbances
CPT 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) is indicated
The service is indicated to optimize rate control and assess for further arrhythmic burden
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
